u0: Start of the mission: the matching key has not yet been seen. Explore the central hallway and side rooms, especially the left-column rooms where the key is known to hide, and watch for the key in the forward view. Next objective: locate the key so key_found becomes true and advance to u1.
u1: The matching key has been located in view, but the agent is not yet carrying it. Approach the key cell, ensure hands are empty, and pick it up. Next objective: gain possession of the matching key so has_matching_key becomes true and advance to u2.
u2: The agent carries the matching key but the locked door guarding the target room is still closed. Navigate to the right-column locked door and toggle it with the key. Next objective: open the locked target door so target_door_open becomes true and advance to u3.
u3: The locked target door is open, but the agent has not yet entered the target room. Move through the doorway or onto a cell inside the target room (the doorway counts as inside). Note the key must be dropped before the ball can be picked up. Next objective: enter the target room so target_room_entered becomes true and advance to u4.
u4: The agent is inside the target room and must pick up the mission's ball, while the locked door must still be open on the pickup step. If carrying the key, drop it first, then pick up the ball with the door open to finish. If the door has been shut, return to u3 to reopen it and re-enter. Next objective: pick up the designated ball with target_door_open true so target_picked_up holds and advance to final state u5.
u5: Terminal success: the mission's ball has been picked up while the target door was open. The episode ends and the accumulated reward is retained. No further objective.
